answer.reason: The verses tell of Tibni being followed by half the people as a rival to Omri, and of his death when Omri prevailed.

clauses.english: was followed by half of Israel, who wanted to make him king against Omri
clauses.quote: half of the people followed Tibni the son of Ginath, to make him king

clauses.english: died after the people following Omri prevailed over his followers
clauses.quote: the people that followed Omri prevailed against the people that followed Tibni

doubts: The identifying phrase already states that half of Israel wanted him as king, so the first clause partly overlaps it; kept because it names the rivalry with Omri.
